group.label: General
group.comment: When enabled, the default theme footer is replaced by this footer.

field.label: Space Between Columns (px)
field.comment: Space on the left and right of each column. Example: 16

field.label: Border Between Rows
field.comment: Show a line between two footer rows.

field.label: Row Border Height (px)
field.comment: Example: 1

group.label: Row 1 - Layout
group.comment: Sections of this row are placed in the number of columns set below. Sections beyond that wrap into the next line.

field.label: Tablet Columns (768px - 1023px)
field.comment: Ignored when Accordion is set to Mobile and Tablet (sections are then 100% wide).

field.label: Mobile Columns (below 768px)
field.comment: Ignored when Accordion is on for mobile (sections are then 100% wide).

field.label: Accordion
field.comment: No Accordion: sections are always open. Mobile only: collapsible below 768px. Mobile and Tablet: collapsible below 1024px.

field.label: Content Alignment
field.comment: Alignment of the title, text, links, image, social links, newsletter and payment icons of this section.

field.label: Width % (optional)
field.comment: Leave empty to use equal width from the row columns. If set, applies on desktop (1024px and above) only. Example: 30

field.label: Text / Description
field.comment: Used by Text and Newsletter types. Allowed HTML: b, strong, i, em, br, a, p, span.

field.label: Image
field.comment: Used by Text (logo) and Image types. Allowed: jpg, png, gif, svg, webp.

field.label: Image Width (px)
field.comment: Leave empty for original size.

field.comment: Used by Links and Social Links types. Click Add Link for each link.
